description.value:
Cast part of casting Verse of Silence

Frequency once per day

Range as Verse of Silence

When you cast Verse of Silence, you may also target one bio-augment within its range belonging to any creature, ally or enemy. For 1 minute, that augment stops functioning entirely — no bonus, no ability — as though the wearer's Load had dropped to 0 for that augment alone. It resumes working the instant the minute ends or Verse of Silence is countered, whichever comes first.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. ItemAlteration alters items belonging to the actor the rule element's parent item is on; there's no mechanism for a rule element on the Plaguesworn's own feat to reach into a different actor's inventory and alter one of their items.
